name: sendgrid
description: Twilio SendGrid: send email (simple fields or dynamic templates; agent sends need an opt-in and an optional recipient allowlist), templates, stats and suppression lists

nodes.title: Send email
nodes.description: Send an email (text/html or a dynamic template) to one set of recipients; accepted with 202 and no body (as an agent tool only when SENDGRID_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

from.description: Sender address; must be a verified Sender Identity or on an authenticated domain

to.description: Recipient addresses, e.g. ["ada@example.com"] (plain addresses, no display names)

subject.description: Subject (required unless template_id is a dynamic template with its own subject)

template_id.description: Template id; d-... for dynamic templates (then subject/text/html come from the template)

dynamic_template_data.description: Handlebars data for a dynamic template, e.g. {first_name: "Ada"}

send_at.description: Unix time to send at (at most 72 hours ahead)

asm_group_id.description: Unsubscribe group id (list_unsubscribe_groups) for the unsubscribe link

sandbox_mode.description: Validate the request without sending (nothing is delivered)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: SendGrid v3 API request
nodes.description: Call any SendGrid v3 API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/categories". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read paths under /templates, /stats, /categories, /suppression, /asm, /messages, /verified_senders, /whitelabel/domains, /geo/stats, /devices/stats, /clients/stats, /mailbox_providers/stats, /browsers/stats.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/categories"
